title: iPod Touch - Wikipedia
snippet:
The iPod Touch was the last product in Apple's iPod product line after the discontinuation of the iPod Nano and iPod Shuffle on July 27, 2017, after which Apple revised the storage and pricing for the iPod Touch with 32 and 128 GB of storage. On May 10, 2022, Apple discontinued the iPod Touch, effectively ending the iPod product line. The last iOS version to support the seventh-generation iPod Touch is iOS 15.

Apple Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Cupertino, California that designs, develops, and sells consumer electronics, computer software, and online services. Some of Apple's major products include the iPhone, iPad, Mac computers, iPod, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and HomePod. Apple also develops operating systems like macOS, iOS, watchOS, and tvOS. title: A History of iPhone Invites — Basic Apple Guy
snippet:
Apple EarPods were announced (if you thought I was talking about AirPods, I envy your youth).
 Fifth-generation iPod touch announced: A 4-inch Retina display, A5 chip, 5MP camera, 1080p recording, Siri, and a colourful aluminum body. A small retractable attachment point supported the included wrist loop.
 Seventh-generation iPod nano: A 2.5-inch Multi-Touch screen, Bluetooth audio, FM radio, a physical Home button, and Lightning.

## 2013 - iPhone 5s & 5c [...] Fifth-generation iPad Air: The M1 chip came to the 10.9-inch Air, joined by optional 5G and a Center Stage front camera.
 Mac Studio: A new desktop machine offered M1 Max or M1 Ultra processors and would ultimately dethrone the Mac Pro as Apple’s most powerful Mac.
 M1 Ultra: Apple connected two M1 Max dies, producing configurations with a 20-core CPU, up to a 64-core GPU, and up to 128GB of unified memory. [...] iPad Pro (9.7-inch): A smaller version of the iPad Pro was announced with a A9X chip, four-speaker audio, Pencil support, and Smart Keyboard compatibility. This iPad also introduced True Tone, which adjusted the display’s white balance to surrounding light. Its 12MP camera could record 4K video.
 Apple refreshed Watch bands with woven nylon options and lowered the starting Watch price to $299.
